goal:
Execute the Scene web view plan in this repository.

A TypeScript page served by the existing Python process. It shows the Lisbon quicklook and metadata, starts the measurement as one background job, and displays the current step sentence until the briefing and the numbers are on screen. RAG, LangChain, Ollama, Docker, and Kubernetes stay out of this cycle.

This iteration adds a local web view. Python keeps the scene, the job, and the measurement. TypeScript is the page only. The running command stays `python3 app.py` on `127.0.0.1:8765`.

Out of this cycle, even if an agent has time left: RAG, LangChain, a local Ollama model, Docker, and Kubernetes.

The page has three regions. The preview is the quicklook and the STAC facts. The run region has one primary button, a spinner, a step count, and one sentence. The results region fills when a measurement exists: the numbers, the overview image, and the briefing. A limit line stays visible: a row is a bright return, and the page has not named a ship.

On load, GET /api/scene returns the last measurement and briefing if those files are already on disk, so the results region is filled before anyone presses the button. Pressing the button starts a new run and replaces them when the job finishes.

Until ui/dist/index.html exists, GET / keeps serving today's HTML from lisbon_scene/page.py. After the build exists, GET / serves that file. Hashed assets are cached. index.html is not.

Contract — all implementors use these shapes. The page displays sentence as written. It does not invent step text.

GET /api/scene
- scene_id, collected_at, start_at, end_at, platform, mode, band, polarizations, orbit_state, incidence_angle, bbox as [west, south, east, north]
- preview_url: /quicklook.png when the quicklook loaded, otherwise null
- measurement: the public object from intelligence/measurements.json, or null
- briefing_html: HTML from lisbon_scene/markdown.py, or null
- overview_url: /overview.png when that file exists, otherwise null

POST /api/jobs/measure with an empty body. 202 and { job_id, status: running }. 409 when a job is already running.

GET /api/jobs/current
- status: idle, running, done, or failed
- step_index and step_count (9)
- sentence: the active step, in this order
  1. Checking that the GRD is on disk.
  2. Checking that the dwell stack is on disk.
  3. Checking the sub-aperture image.
  4. Measuring dark water and the deck return.
  5. Tracking bright returns across the dwell.
  6. Comparing each return with its sub-aperture neighborhood.
  7. Recording the SLC sidecar without detecting on it.
  8. Drawing the overview.
  9. Writing the measurement, the GeoJSON, and the briefing.
- error: a short reason when failed, otherwise null
- result: on done, the same measurement, briefing_html, and overview_url fields as the scene route; otherwise null

A missing raster fails the job with a sentence that names the file and python3 scene.py --all. The button does not start that download. The SLC stays a sidecar note.

The page polls every 400 ms while running, then stops. A failed job leaves the previous result on screen and shows error beside the spinner.

Page: Vite, React, and TypeScript under ui/, installed and built with pnpm. No component library, no router, no state library, no map. @/ maps to ui/src. One BEM stylesheet per region, no inline styles and no !important. The product path is the Python server. Do not use pnpm dev as the way to run the tool. pnpm --dir ui build writes ui/dist.

Visual: keep the current paper page and dark radar image from static/scene.css. UI chrome in a system sans. The briefing stays in a serif. The spinner honors prefers-reduced-motion. The measure button is a real button with a visible focus ring, disabled while a job is running.

Preview facts are the ones already on the page: collected time, window, platform, mode, band, polarization, orbit, incidence, bounding box. The image is /quicklook.png.

Results show water area, the two basins, deck length and width with the layover line, each return's motion, area, speed, and peak sigma0, then the briefing HTML. The overview image sits with those numbers.

Browser errors keep posting to /client-error.

Four chunks: (1) Python job API, (2) preview shell, (3) run and results, (4) join after 1-3.
summary: Lisbon scene web view: Python job API plus a TypeScript page that previews the collect and runs one measurement

tasks.name: python-job-api
tasks.scopedGoal:
Add the measurement job API to the existing Python process. Do not add TypeScript, Docker, RAG, LangChain, Ollama, or Kubernetes.

Discovered facts (this clone, main at 3dbd233):
- Entry is app.py -> lisbon_scene.web.build_state/serve. ThreadingHTTPServer on 127.0.0.1:8765.
- dispatch() in lisbon_scene/web.py handles GET /, /quicklook.png, /static/scene.css, /static/scene.js, POST /client-error. Unknown paths 404. It never serves the data directory.
- AppState is a frozen dataclass: scene, note_markdown, quicklook, static_files. Keep that shape; add job state elsewhere (lisbon_scene/jobs.py), not by stuffing rasters into AppState.
- make_handler currently: POST requires Content-Length and caps every POST at 2048 bytes (_MAX_CLIENT_ERROR_BYTES) before dispatch; _reply always sends Cache-Control: no-store. Empty POST /api/jobs/measure must succeed (Content-Length 0 or missing treated as empty). Keep /client-error cap and behavior. Vary cache: hashed ui/dist assets may be cached (public, immutable); index.html and JSON API must not be cached.
- analyze.py:main() currently wait_for('grd-cog.tif'), wait_for('vid-cog.tif'), optional wait_for('csi-cog.tif'), then measure, overview, write_products, briefing. wait_for HEAD-requests the remote and can block for hours. That wait/download path must not run from the web job. The button does not start a download.
- intelligence/measurements.json and intelligence/briefing.md are in git. intelligence/overview.png is gitignored. data/ is gitignored; cloud clones usually have no rasters and no STAC. tests/test_web.py, tests/test_page.py, tests/test_loader.py call load_scene()/build_state() and need data/stac.json plus qlk-cog.tif. Do not download products. Job tests must not open a raster and must not call scene.py.
- lisbon_scene/markdown.py:render_markdown is the briefing HTML renderer. Reuse it for briefing_html.
- SceneRecord fields (loader.py) map 1:1 onto the scene JSON: scene_id, collected_at, start_at, end_at, platform, mode, band, polarizations (list), orbit_state, incidence_angle, bbox as [west, south, east, north].
- mypy is strict on app.py, lisbon_scene, tests (not analyze.py). New jobs.py and web.py changes must typecheck. pyproject ruff E,F,I,UP, line length 88.
- python3 analyze.py must still run the same work via run_measurement.

Implement:
1. analyze.py: pull the body of main into run_measurement(on_step). on_step(index, sentence) is called at each of the nine steps below, in order, with 1-based index matching the list. python3 analyze.py still calls run_measurement (print/log the sentence if on_step is a default). Do not keep the 6-hour wait_for poll on the job path. Fail immediately when a required raster is missing.
   Sentences, exact text:
   1. Checking that the GRD is on disk.
   2. Checking that the dwell stack is on disk.
   3. Checking the sub-aperture image.
   4. Measuring dark water and the deck return.
   5. Tracking bright returns across the dwell.
   6. Comparing each return with its sub-aperture neighborhood.
   7. Recording the SLC sidecar without detecting on it.
   8. Drawing the overview.
   9. Writing the measurement, the GeoJSON, and the briefing.
   Required rasters: data/grd-cog.tif (GRD) and data/vid-cog.tif (dwell stack). CSI (csi-cog.tif) is optional as today; still call on_step for sentence 3. SLC is a sidecar note only (slc_note); do not detect on it. A missing required raster fails with a short error sentence that names the file and includes `python3 scene.py --all`. Do not start that download.
2. lisbon_scene/jobs.py: one background thread, one lock. POST starts run_measurement in that thread. Inject the runner so tests can pass a fake (do not import/open rasters in tests). Status idle | running | done | failed. step_count is 9. On done, result is {measurement, briefing_html, overview_url} with the same meaning as GET /api/scene. On failed, error is the short reason and result is null. Starting a job while status is running raises/returns 409. job_id is a new id per start.
3. lisbon_scene/web.py routes:
   - GET /api/scene: JSON contract. preview_url is /quicklook.png if quicklook loaded else null. measurement is the public object from intelligence/measurements.json if that file exists else null. briefing_html is render_markdown of intelligence/briefing.md if that file exists else null. overview_url is /overview.png if intelligence/overview.png exists else null. Do not serve overview from anywhere else.
   - POST /api/jobs/measure, empty body: 202 {job_id, status: running}; 409 when a job is already running.
   - GET /api/jobs/current: {status, step_index, step_count, sentence, error, result}. idle when never started. JSON content-type.
   - GET /overview.png: intelligence/overview.png only; 404 if missing.
   - GET /: if ui/dist/index.html exists, serve that file (do not cache). Else keep today's render_page HTML. Serve other files that exist under ui/dist (typical Vite /assets/<hash>.*) with hashed-asset caching. Refuse path traversal. Keep /client-error and /quicklook.png and /static/*.
4. tests/test_jobs.py: drive a fake runner through running, done, failed, and the 409 case. Do not open a raster. Cover GET /api/scene shape (you may construct AppState / a temp briefing file; do not require data/stac.json if you can avoid it). Cover POST 202/409 and GET /api/jobs/current. Cover GET / serving fallback HTML when ui/dist is absent, and serving ui/dist/index.html when you create a temp file. Cover /overview.png only from intelligence/overview.png.

Do not edit ui/, README.md, lisbon_scene/page.py, lisbon_scene/loader.py, or static/.
